title: YggdrasilSharedDefinitions
description: Shared semantic-dimension value families and common types for the Yggdrasil architecture contracts (#2544-#2548). Single source of truth for the orthogonal dimensions defined in docs/architecture/semantic-dimensions.md so the five contract schemas cannot drift or collapse roles. Enum value families mirror semantic-dimensions.md and are extensible there, not here.

object_type.description: The kind of usable Yggdrasil object a metadata bundle describes. From docs/architecture/functional-ontology.md.

source_role.description: Where the object came from and what kind of source it is (origin). SIP-owned. Orthogonal to authority_state and evidence_role. `general_knowledge` is a source role / eligibility signal, never a cross-scope bypass. Value family mirrors docs/architecture/semantic-dimensions.md (extensible there).

authority_state.description: What standing the object currently has. GOV-owned; changed only by a governed AuthorityTransition with an AuthorityReceipt. Orthogonal to source_role and evidence_role.

canonical_authority_state.description: The subset of authority_state values that denote durable, accepted human-knowledge standing. Reaching one of these requires a governed AuthorityTransition + AuthorityReceipt.

evidence_role.description: What the object may do in reasoning (admissibility). GOV-owned admissibility, consumed by RCA/CAO. Orthogonal to source_role and authority_state; does not grant cross-scope retrieve/cite rights.

non_authoritative_evidence_role.description: Evidence roles that explicitly exclude real-world `evidence` standing. Used by projections and machine memory, which are not factual evidence by default.

sensitivity.description: How confidential the object is; who may see it. GOV-owned policy dimension; governs disclosure, not reasoning standing.

suppression_state.description: Whether the object is currently withheld, redacted, or tombstoned from surfacing/use. GOV-owned; honored by HIX/RCA/DRI. Suppression hides; it does not erase lineage or authority history.

memory_state.description: Coarse machine-memory lifecycle position. MEM-owned; the promotion transition is GOV-owned. Specialized memory value family (extends the initial family in semantic-dimensions.md). `promoted` reflects a governed transition into HKA; it does not by itself confer canonical authority. Suppression, invalidation, tombstone, and purge stub are distinct states.

promotion_state.description: Fine machine-memory promotion sub-lifecycle. MEM may request promotion; only GOV authorizes and HKA materializes it.

sync_state.description: Replication/convergence status across nodes. SFC-owned. Never implies authority, scope membership, or evidence role.

execution_state.description: Status of an authorized side effect. EXE-owned status; GOV owns the authorization. `authorized` reflects a prior GOV grant/receipt; execution cannot authorize itself.

cross_scope_operation.description: A distinct cross-scope operation. Each is granted separately; granting one never implies another. From docs/architecture/cross-scope-flow.md.

admissibility_status.description: Whether a retrieval candidate has been admitted for use in the current context. Candidate generation is distinct from admission; admission is a GOV decision, not a similarity outcome.

scope_binding.description: Which scope(s) the object belongs to. WSP-owned (policy facet GOV). Membership only; it never grants cross-scope rights. scope_id is the primary binding; additional_scope_ids covers multi-scope membership.

citation_range.description: A citable span anchored in a source object, preserving provenance/citation ranges. Citation references a basis; it does not copy or grant mutation.

cross_scope_flow_ref.description: A typed CrossScopeFlow grant in effect, referencing docs/architecture/cross-scope-flow.md. Directional (source -> target), operation-specific, bounded. Presence of a flow is required for any cross-scope use; similarity is not permission.

scope_denial.description: A reference to denied or out-of-context scope material that records WHY it is denied/escalated WITHOUT leaking its content. Denied material must never be passed as hidden context.

extensions.description: Explicit, bounded extension point for runtime evolution. Use instead of arbitrary additional top-level properties so the closed contract stays auditable.
